CreateSandboxLocationRequest.description: The request object for creating a sandbox location.

channels.description: The list of channels to enable for the location.

locationName.description: The name for the sandbox location.

merchantIds.description: The list of merchant identifiers to create the location for.

CreateSandboxLocationResponse.description: The response object for creating a sandbox location.

Error.description: An error response returned when the request is unsuccessful.

code.description: An error code that identifies the type of error that occurred.

details.description: Additional details that can help the caller understand or fix the issue.

message.description: A message that describes the error condition.

ErrorList.description: A list of error responses returned when a request is unsuccessful.

LocationIdMap.description: A map of channel to location identifier.

FBA.description: The location identifier for the FBA channel.

MFN.description: The location identifier for the MFN channel.
